checks.evidence: The System 2.0 loader returned to 0x0223D1D0 with Gate ID 21 selected and populated the 64-byte cache at 0x02293C20 with record ID 21, format version 1, valid flag 1, and arena entry 0. Cache SHA-256 was 8ecef0a63d0ba161fe000ab688d847fe774bbbd4a5da412d281eb68d9d1b657d.
checks.name: cache_initialization

checks.evidence: The normal Gate-result removal path returned to 0x022424B8 after the System 2.0 clear hook at 0x022424B4. All 64 cache bytes were zero; SHA-256 was f5a5fd42d16a20302798ef6ed309979b43003d2320d9f0e8ea9831a92759fb4b.
checks.name: cache_invalidation

checks.evidence: Cache state is match-local: battle construction writes one validated selected record, and result/removal resets the complete 64-byte region to zero before execution resumes.
checks.name: cache_reset

checks.evidence: Any failed file operation or invalid G2DT magic, version, geometry, card ID, reserved field, or CRC leaves the cache invalid and preserves the original Gate path.
checks.name: malformed_fallback

checks.evidence: FS_CloseFile is 0x0200AADC with r0=FSFile*. A clean-boot call returned 1 and cleared archive, command, and file status state in the same 72-byte handle.
checks.name: nitrofs_close

checks.evidence: FS_OpenFileFast is 0x0200AA24 with r0=FSFile*, r1=FSArchive*, and r2=file ID. File ID 2762 was observed through this interface on a clean boot.
checks.name: nitrofs_open

checks.evidence: FS_ReadFile is 0x0200AC30 with r0=FSFile*, r1=destination, and r2=length. Runtime calls returned the exact bytes read and advanced position by the same amount; reads clamp to the remaining file range.
checks.name: nitrofs_read

checks.evidence: FS_SeekFile is 0x0200AC40 with SET/CUR/END modes 0/1/2. Runtime SET/0 returned 1; decoded code confirms clamping and invalid-mode failure without position mutation.
checks.name: nitrofs_seek

checks.evidence: The expanded overlay preserves the original 0x640-byte BSS as zero-backed payload bytes at the original addresses before the new 0x8000-byte module.
checks.name: original_bss_preservation

checks.evidence: Overlay 7 grows from 0x721A0 to 0x7A7E0 decoded bytes, ends at cache start 0x02293C20, and moves arena low atomically to 0x02293C60 below arena high 0x023E0000.
checks.name: overlay_growth

checks.evidence: The host loader accepts only the exact 32-byte G2DT header, 103 ordered 40-byte records, supported version, matching payload geometry, zero reserved fields, and valid header/payload CRC-32 values.
checks.name: trailer_validation

runtime_cache_lifecycle.method: Exact-profile ROM rebuilt with the approved overlay expansion, 576-byte reference loader module, Gate-construction load hook, result/removal clear hook, and arena-low reservation; observed through one DeSmuME ARM9 GDB session from a clean battery-save launch.
